recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to ValueSet.compose or ValueSet.expansion guidance should be made under a later current work-group decision rather than by reintroducing the FHIR-14790 wording that was rejected as not clearer.
issue_request: FHIR-14790 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 ValueSet issue asking for more detail about the differences and uses of ValueSet.compose and ValueSet.expansion. The accepted modification rejected the proposed extra local prose and instead required a hyperlink to the .compose element definition and an updated ValueSet.compose definition describing the Content Logical Definition (CLD).
initial_application: The issue was pre-applied in SVN revision 13351, represented in git as d90f55e1cb. That commit updated source/valueset/valueset-introduction.xml to link .compose to its element definition and updated the then-authoritative source/valueset/valueset-spreadsheet.xml ValueSet.compose row to the approved CLD definition. The old spreadsheet source was later migrated into the current StructureDefinition source layout.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps ValueSet active in the current build. The current introduction still links .compose to valueset-definitions.html#ValueSet.compose, and source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml preserves the approved CLD definition. Current ValueSet notes also explain compose-only, expansion-only, both, and neither cases. Confluence minutes corroborate the Vocab WG 5-0-0 approval of the documented FHIR-14790/FHIR-14791 changes; community searches found no conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current authoritative source already implements the approved clarification.

related_jiras.note: Paired 2018 ValueSet compose/expansion issue handled in the same SVN 13351 application; it is already represented on the combined branch by its own audit commit.
